_source: Extracted from Figma "Circle" design system file (Ml7pn8kazowJZLyWNOn268) — Components page (Badge, Button, CheckRow, StatChip) and the Create account / Login screens. Two variable collections coexist in the source file; where they conflicted, the collection used by the reusable Components page (Badge/CheckRow/StatChip) won for trust-surface work, since that's the vocabulary Assay's trust components are built from.

color._note.text.tertiary: Used for 'unknown'/not-disclosed states on CheckRow and StatChip captions — pulled straight from source rather than smoothed into text.secondary, since the source clearly used it as a distinct muted tone for exactly this kind of state.
color._note.state.danger.primary: source only exposed the saturated badge danger red (#fc1d1d, meant for white-on-red fills); derived a darker on-light text/icon tone from it for the 'flagged' state so it passes contrast on white the same way state.success.primary/state.warning.primary do.
color._note.state.unknown: not present in source as a semantic color — derived from text.tertiary (#a3959e) and a lightened tint of it, to give 'Not disclosed' the same subtle-pill treatment as the other verification states rather than leaving it without one.

type._note: Header/display face is JetBrains Mono Extrabold in source (used for page/card titles) — a monospace display face reads as 'instrument/ledger' rather than 'marketing', which happens to suit a verification product. Body/UI face is Sora (Bold for labels & buttons, Light for input/body text). Badge/chip/caption face is Poppins SemiBold/Regular at small sizes. Kept all three as observed rather than collapsing to one family.

space._note: 1-4 observed directly (space/xs, space/s, space/m, space/l in source). 6/8/12 extrapolated on the same ~1.5x rhythm for page-level layout since the source components only needed up to 16px.

radius._note: xxs (buttons), xs (inputs), sm (stat chip/card), lg (badge pill) all observed directly.

shadow._note: Observed on the Create account/Login card surfaces (drop-shadow-[2px_4px_6px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)]). No overlay/modal shadow was present in the source; overlay uses a heavier derived value in tokens.css.
